cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of plain-language-response (plain-language-final-response-translator) with contract handoff to render-export-evidence
cases.inputPrompt: Use plain-language-response to translate our technical quality-check and pre-handoff ledger (Runtime: Not Run, Artifact: Not Produced, 1 pending license check on pedestal mesh) into plain language for a brand manager.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (verified_workflow_and_evidence_state) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces plain_language_stakeholder_response, explicit_runtime_and_artifact_status_block, jargon_free_next_steps for role plain-language-final-response-translator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to render-export-evidence (Upstream artifact evidence classification)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs plain_language_stakeholder_response, explicit_runtime_and_artifact_status_block, jargon_free_next_steps conforming to skills/plain-language-response/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to render-export-evidence in skills/plain-language-response/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete plain_language_stakeholder_response and hand off to render-export-evidence (Upstream artifact evidence classification).
simulatedOutput.summary: Translated technical workflow state into a jargon-free stakeholder summary separating verified planning items from unrun Blender execution and naming the single next action. Delivered plain-language summary, verified vs unverified split, single next action and routed to render-export-evidence.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from plain-language-response to scene-readiness
cases.inputPrompt: While applying plain-language-response, the workflow context is {"quality.domain":"holistic","stage.current":"quality_validation"} (Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (scene-readiness)). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/plain-language-response/contract.json
Routes to scene-readiness (Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (scene-readiness)) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to scene-readiness

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to scene-readiness (Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (scene-readiness)).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from plain-language-response to scene-readiness under context {"quality.domain":"holistic","stage.current":"quality_validation"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in plain-language-response
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during plain-language-response with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for plain-language-response and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for plain-language-response.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (verified_workflow_and_evidence_state) for plain-language-response halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Write a final plain-language status update for the stakeholder without providing the current workflow stage, truth-state labels, or any blocker notes.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'verified_workflow_and_evidence_state' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing upstream truth-state ledger and blocker/check summary required by plain-language-response (verified_workflow_and_evidence_state)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: upstream truth-state ledger and blocker/check summary
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'verified_workflow_and_evidence_state' (upstream truth-state ledger and blocker/check summary)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing upstream truth-state ledger and blocker/check summary (verified_workflow_and_evidence_state) before plain-language-response locks plain_language_stakeholder_response.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted plain-language-response due to missing required input 'verified_workflow_and_evidence_state' (upstream truth-state ledger and blocker/check summary); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent upstream truth-state ledger and blocker/check summary when 'verified_workflow_and_evidence_state' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success) is excluded from plain-language-response and delegated to render-export-evidence
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of convert technical blender workflow findings into plain-language user-facing responses with honest caveats., handle this request inside plain-language-response: to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/plain-language-response/contract.json when to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success
Delegates to render-export-evidence (Delegates out-of-scope requests to render-export-evidence) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for plain-language-response (to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success); delegate to render-export-evidence.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced plain-language-response exclusion boundary (Delegates out-of-scope requests to render-export-evidence) and delegated to render-export-evidence.
